## Compact sidebar

- **The usage blocks are half the height.** Codex and OpenCode Go now show one line per window — `7d 10% · resets 6d 5h` — instead of three, and the redundant "(NN% left)" percentage is gone.
- The runout line appears only when a runout is predicted, and it warns with `⚠ runs out 2h` (colored) when the window would run out before its reset.
- The daily pace line appears only when it is meaningful (`+10.0%/day`); the old `avg 0.0%/day` filler rows no longer take space.
- The sidebar itself is **4 columns narrower** (38 instead of 42), giving the conversation its room back.

## Collapsed thinking shows the tail

- A collapsed thinking block now previews the **end** of the thought instead of the beginning — where the conclusion and the actual plan usually live.
- The preview is sized to the visible conversation width, so the terminal's right-edge clipping can no longer cut off the very part you asked for.

Full suite: 387 tests — 386 pass, 1 skip.
